# LLM provider configuration

Provider selection, model defaults, and model execution policy.

Defaults come from the schema when declared, otherwise from the bundled YAML. An object
with listed children is expanded below; `{…}` and `[…]` summarize compound defaults. A
dash means the schema has no finite allowed-value list.

| <a id="llm_provider-model_aliases-builtin"></a>`llm_provider.model_aliases.builtin`                                                                                                             | object           | not set                                                          | —                                                                              | Overrides for SASE's built-in size aliases: xsmall, small, medium, large, and xlarge. See src/sase/llm_provider/models.yml for the current shipped default of each alias. Values are bare known models, explicit provider/model targets, nested provider-local model paths, or '@&lt;alias&gt;' references; a reference may carry a trailing '@&lt;effort&gt;' that overrides the referenced alias's effort. Single-pipe values (A \| B) form load-balanced round-robin pools; a pool member may be prefixed with a positive integer weight and a space (A \| 3 B, weights 1-99) to favor that member. Double-pipe values (A \|\| B) form ordered provider-availability fallbacks and cannot carry weights. Parenthesize a pool to attach a last-resort tail ((A \| B) \|\| C); unparenthesized mixing is still rejected. Every member uses the same grammar and may carry a trailing @&lt;effort&gt;. |
